text: Prior art (13 repos plus LaunchBar, Late Night Software forum, dwarvesf/hidden, Chromium and Telegram WebK sources): every tool that opens a notification does AXPress or the localized Show action on the live NC element (NotificationNanny, vorssaint-utils, macos-notification-cli, LaunchBar). Nobody delivers a click after the notification has gone to history except through the visible NC panel: clock AXPress, find the entry, expand its BannerStack, press (AriSweedler notif-center, roycetech, talon-axkit; OmniWM does the same lookup by UUID but only for dismiss and reply). Nobody avoids the panel flash, and nobody has tried moving the panel's window off-screen. Chromium never focuses the tab itself: the click goes to the page's onclick or the service worker's notificationclick, and Telegram WebK focuses the chat there, so only the real click reaches the right chat. Chromium reports kClose to the page when macOS no longer lists the notification, so the interceptor closing a banner also kills its click. Vivaldi's Info.plist sets banner style, yet all Vivaldi and Slack notifications in the last 7 days showed no banner (per-app style, likely None). The usernoted DB's displayed/delivered tables list UUIDs still in NC. Chromium userInfo (notificationOrigin) may be in req.usda (unverified). Pending verification: AXPress on a history-panel entry delivers the click. Blocked: the screen was locked, so clock AXPress was ignored.
